policy: Source branch audit and one fixed numerical case per new mechanism; no screenshot, skin, or facing sweep. Package presence is not completeness.

idolcaptain.identity: 偶像骑士团长伊娃 / idol_captain / OriginId 315
certainErrors: Old package omitted heroOptionIds, weapons, awakening and buffs, so source option activation could not be respected.
ManualSoundWave basic aura was born at action start; native OnStateUpdate creates it at first ShootFrame.
DashFrame hop .3 high was omitted; native Jump uses the entire DashFrame interval, including a legal tail beyond action end.
Third basic fixed projectile-color order; native each shot randomly selects and removes an index from the remaining list.
Normal-action-triggered CWP ownership buff FX had no runtime consumer; source has a CoolTime gate and myth preset override.
alreadySupported: EnhanceActionName is the existing third ManualSoundWave action in both native styles, not a hidden replacement or fourth attack.
IdolCaptainSpecialOption uses that name to double healing and, with active myth option, apply healing/buff to living stage members. It contains no explicit FX spawn.
bounds: Only existing preview owner receives CWP ownership FX; real stage-party members and their summonables require battle-party state.
Healing target selection and damage reduction are gameplay rules; no invented HP trigger or alternate action is added.
Native default flag=false preserves reverse Angle indexing through TriggerInfo; alternate network flag snapshots are outside this fixed preview.
CWP rainbow screen/world mixed-node projection remains the separately documented source candidate; this audit does not certify its visual shape.

villainredhood.identity: 红斗篷团伙领导人阿拉贝尔 / villain_redhood / OriginId 307
certainErrors: Final stamina-break shot omitted native RecoilType1(distance .3000000119, height .2000000030, duration .2750000060, angle 8).
Equipped option branch was gated only by exclusiveWeapon boolean, instead of valid OptionId membership.
alreadySupported: Constructor reads normal ProjectileName from valid ManualMythOptionId data and keeps original SuperProjectileName.
Constructor reads extra ProjectileName from equipped OptionId before EnhancedCwpMythOptionId. The latter changes only DpsMultiplier .75 to .9, and has no alternate projectile.
GetAttackType chooses extra-shot attack type 2 only when equipped option is valid and cwpOptionTimePassed <= 0; StartAttack resets to 3 seconds; OnUpdateFrame decrements it.
OnUpdateFrameAttack ends at .25 seconds independent of weapon ShootTerm .35. Six-round preview already follows .25 clock.
VillainRedhoodSpecialOption damage callback grants movement SpeedScale and Critical buffs. Its script and referenced buff records have no FX spawn.
bounds: Myth manual SpeedIncreaseRate .25 exists in metadata but is not read by the inspected launcher constructor or ManualDiscreteStamina constructor; do not change the firing clock from this field alone.
The fixed preview does not simulate terrain, full battle collision, or damage commands.

legacyOverrideLesson: A nonempty per-character native-action-plans.json override bypasses plans_for and all new source compilation. Only idolcaptain stale entry removed here. Keep unsupported legacy/augment plans; do not globally prioritize unreviewed source compilation.
